## The advance: let the receiver determine what calibration must learn

**In the stated Gaussian dephasing model, a complete quantum receiver can be certified from one acquired average-error statistic—even when a few individual noise rates are arbitrarily large and unknown.** The construction uses the code’s ability to correct errors in arbitrary locations to remove the need to identify those noisy coordinates.

This changes the calibration problem. Microscopic coupling reconstruction is one sufficient route to protection, but the intended operation can require substantially less information. I developed that distinction into ordinary proofs, finite acquisition procedures, executable checks and a complete accounting of the remaining physical operations.

The strongest result is a structural and computational advance. **A practical total-resource advantage over the best informed architecture remains unproved.** Long interrogation times, finite controls, drift and the quantum receiver can still dominate.

The complete account is in :chatgpt-content-reference{index="6"}[MAIN_RESULT.md](producer-workspace/MAIN_RESULT.md).

## 1. A receiver can tolerate what calibration cannot resolve

The target remains an unknown quantum register, possibly entangled with a reference, passed through a specified encoder, storage interval and quantum receiver.

On \(m\) physical or acquired coordinates, consider the channel

\[
\mathcal N_T(\rho)
=\mathbb E_\theta\,U_\theta\rho U_\theta^\dagger,
\qquad
U_\theta=\prod_{j=1}^{m}e^{-i\theta_j Z_j},
\qquad
\theta\sim N(0,TQ),
\]

where \(Q\) is any positive-semidefinite covariance matrix. Correlations can be dense and of arbitrary rank. The specified code corrects every phase-error pattern of weight at most \(t\); write \(h=t+1\).

An actual, qualified random \(X\) conjugation before and after storage makes the channel a phase-Pauli channel once the random key is retired. Conditional on \(\theta\), its error bits are independent with probabilities \(\sin^2\theta_j\). The physical randomization, key handling and receiver are part of the procedure.

For this channel, ordinary coding gives the useful baseline

\[
\delta_{\rm logical}
\le \frac{2m\bar p}{h},
\]

where \(\bar p\) is the average phase-error probability at the intended storage time. Here and below, \(\delta\) is the **full diamond norm**, including arbitrary reference entang
